rules.title: Narrow effects and keyed lists
rules.what: Read only the signals an effect needs, share derived values with createMemo, and render lists with <For> (keyed) or <Index> rather than .map.
rules.why: createEffect tracks everything it reads; a broad effect re-runs for unrelated changes, and .map recreates every row, throwing away Solid's fine-grained updates.
rules.how: createMemo for shared derivations; on() or untrack() to scope tracking; <For each={items()}>{item => ...}</For>.

patterns.note: Effect in a file with no memo or scoped tracking.
List rendered with map; <For> keeps unchanged rows.

verify.how: Devtools or a render counter shows updates touching only the intended nodes.

rules.title: Lazy routes, hydration budget
rules.what: Lazy-load routes and widgets and keep hydration and bundle size within a budget measured on low-power devices.
rules.why: Shipping every route up front costs download and parse on devices that will only visit one page.
rules.how: lazy(() => import('./Page')); SolidStart islands where possible; bundle budget in CI.

verify.how: Per-route bundle and hydration time measured on a low-end device profile.
